note: Machine-readable pin of every external dependency. Cached generations in data/processed/generations_* are the authoritative record of what each provider returned; this file records under what versions.
model_config:
# FreshBench-RAG — generator configuration (REAL run)
#
generator:
  provider: anthropic
  model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001   # frontier reference; closed-book knee at 2025
  max_tokens: 64
  temperature: 0.0                    # deterministic main pass
  system_prompt: |
    You are a precise question-answering system. Answer the question with the
    shortest possible span (a name, number, date, or short phrase). Do not
    explain. If evidence documents are provided, answer using them.
  concurrency: 12                      # parallel API calls
  max_retries: 5
